outcome: Pregnancy outcomes (termination of pregnancy, early neonatal death, spontaneous regression, favorable outcome after neonatal surgery)
cohort: The study included 13 cases of neonatal volvulus identified from 2006-2017 based on postnatal and prenatal imaging findings.
finding: The identification of the whirlpool sign or a fluid-filled level within dilated loops improves the accuracy of ultrasound findings for suspected fetal midgut volvulus, and the prognosis appears good in the absence of total volvulus or association with cystic fibrosis.
